title: Hub authority chain permission vocabulary
description: The system permission ids the hub authority chain evaluates (wire spec 2026-11-24-encryption-v2-wire-format §5.4, §5.6; #2963). packages/crypto/src/hub_chain.rs holds the same vocabulary as constants (it builds without packages/protocol/) and its test vocabulary_matches_protocol_json pins them to this file: roleManagement authorises role_grant, role_revoke, purpose and connector group_epoch, connector_*, policy, checkpoint and recovery_group links; escrow-management is every permission of every reader purpose (the same rule as the escrow-key route); readerPurposes maps each closed purpose word to the permissions whose holders are that purpose group's members. packages/shared/permissions.ts READER_PURPOSE_PERMISSIONS must match readerPurposes (pinned by apps/worker/__tests__/unit/hub-chain-permissions-vocabulary.test.ts). Permission ids are concrete: a bundle commits expanded ids, never a wildcard.
